subject: Designer / Draftsperson (South Melbourne): Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Entire hiring team,

I am applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role in your Fire Protection team in South Melbourne, advertised on SEEK (job 95137066).

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I also used Revit for a pedestrian Warren truss bridge model in that course. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project in charge. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a 485 visa.

Your advert says fire protection experience is not required if the candidate brings Revit and AutoCAD and a sharp eye for detail. My Revit and AutoCAD are from study rather than production fire drafting, and I am ready to learn your standards on the job.

Could we talk about the role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Designer / Draftsperson, South Melbourne (SEEK 95137066)
paragraphs: I am applying for the Designer / Draftsperson role in Entire's Fire Protection team in South Melbourne, advertised on SEEK as job 95137066. The role turns briefs into technical design documentation for fire protection systems on Melbourne building projects, including client meetings, site checks and drawings in Revit and AutoCAD.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute in February 2026. Coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards, and I modelled a pedestrian Warren truss bridge in Revit. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from Divine Word College of Legazpi (2014 to 2019).

From April to September 2019 I was project in charge engineer on a community hall renovation in the Philippines, coordinating 10 to 15 workers each day and checking work against drawings. From September 2019 to February 2020 I was a field engineer on subdivision finishing works, preparing progress reports and working with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers.

I have not drafted fire protection systems before. Your advert says that background is not required if the candidate is confident in Revit and AutoCAD, and that Entire teaches the fire protection standards. My software use so far is academic rather than commercial production drafting.

I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card, an Australian driver licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. My resume is attached and study drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I would like to discuss the role.
